readings: Considering only tracks whose Track.Bytes is strictly greater than 10,323,804 (Bytes > 10323804), compute for each media type (by name) the average of the per-track ratio Bytes ÷ Milliseconds, using real-number division. Then compute the simple (unweighted) average of those per-media-type averages. List the media types whose average is strictly higher than that overall average, showing the media type name, its average, and its average minus the overall average. Leave all values unrounded.

Considering only tracks whose Track.Bytes is greater than or equal to 10,323,804 (Bytes >= 10323804), compute for each media type (by name) the average of the per-track ratio Bytes ÷ Milliseconds, using real-number division. Then compute the simple (unweighted) average of those per-media-type averages. List the media types whose average is strictly higher than that overall average, showing the media type name, its average, and its average minus the overall average. Leave all values unrounded.
queries:
WITH m AS (
  SELECT mt.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType mt ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804
  GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId, mt.Name
),
o AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM m
)
SELECT m.Name, m.avg_ratio, m.avg_ratio - o.overall AS diff
FROM m, o
WHERE m.avg_ratio > o.overall;
WITH mt AS (
  SELECT m.Name AS Name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_ratio
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON t.MediaTypeId = m.MediaTypeId
  WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM mt
)
SELECT mt.Name, mt.avg_ratio, mt.avg_ratio - overall.overall_avg AS diff
FROM mt, overall
WHERE mt.avg_ratio > overall.overall_avg;
